# azsubcache_subscription (Resource)

An Azure subscription, claimed from the pool management group or created when the pool is empty. Cancelled on destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "azsubcache_subscription" "sandbox" {
  display_name = "sandbox-${var.track_slug}"
}

output "subscription_id" {
  value = azsubcache_subscription.sandbox.subscription_id
}

# Hand the claimed subscription to the azurerm provider.
provider "azurerm" {
  features {}
  subscription_id = azsubcache_subscription.sandbox.subscription_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Subscription name. A claimed subscription is renamed to this.

### Read-Only

- `from_pool` (Boolean) True if this subscription came from the pool rather than being created.
- `id` (String) Same as subscription_id.
- `subscription_id` (String) The claimed subscription's id, to feed into the azurerm provider.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an already-claimed subscription by its subscription id.
terraform import azsubcache_subscription.sandbox 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
